newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Salomon starts California REITs.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Salomon starts California REITs.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers said analyst Jordan Heller started coverage on four California apartment real estate investment trusts (REITs).

-- Started Bay Apartment Communities Inc and Essex Property Trust Inc with buy ratings. Cited Bay Apartment's dominant presence in San Francisco Bay area and Essex's above-average growth potential and proven ability to opportunistically buy and sell properties in changing markets.

-- Started BRE Properties Inc and Irvine Apartment Communities Inc with hold ratings. Said remains bullish on economic prospects of both but believes market has already valued much of the upside into share prices.
-- Said also remains bullish on California economic fundamentals, noting economic growth has increased apartment demand.
-- Bay Apartment shares rose 1/4 to 29-3/8, BRE Property shares fell 3/8 to 20-1/2, Essex Property shares rose 3/8 to 24-1/2 and Irvine Apartment shares fell 1/8 to 22-3/4.
